workflows.name: Render a Directed Campaign Hero
workflows.description: Select one captured direction deterministically, edit the product reference into a 16:9 hero, and emit its creative contract only after the image succeeds.

data.comment:
# Render a Directed Campaign Hero

Choose A, B, or C from the captured plan. The product image is always first and the optional role-labelled reference is second. The image edit creates no campaign text; the finalizer waits for the image before advancing.

data.description: Validated serialized plan from Propose Three Campaign Directions.

data.name: choice
data.description: Direction ID A, B, or C.

data.negative_prompt: text, lettering, typography, captions, duplicate product, altered logo, cropped product

workflows.name: Compose Directed Campaign Formats
workflows.description: Compose one accepted hero into deterministic 1080×1350 and 1080×1920 PNG and self-contained SVG formats, then export a portable versioned campaign record.

data.comment:
# Compose Directed Campaign Formats

Build 4:5 and 9:16 artboards from the same complete accepted hero. Both PNGs and self-contained SVGs share the exact text element tree. The final step waits for every artifact, preserves the original record when adding a revision, and exports directed-campaign.json.

workflows.name: Revise an Accepted Campaign Hero
workflows.description: Apply one bounded revision to the accepted campaign hero while recording the exact change, preservation instructions, allowed response, and parent contract.

data.comment:
# Revise an Accepted Campaign Hero

The accepted hero is the only editing source. Capture Change, Preserve, and Allow to respond in a child contract, make one image edit, and wait for its result before opening revision review.

workflows.name: Reopen a Directed Campaign
workflows.description: Validate a portable schema-version-1 campaign record and restore its accepted original and optional revision without calling a model.

data.comment:
# Reopen a Directed Campaign

Read directed-campaign.json, validate its version, copy, direction, MIME-labelled base64 payloads, dimensions, and revision ancestry, then recreate typed media references. Validation finishes before any output is written. No provider runs.
